Entries.Title: File lookup failed
Entries.Explanation: The requested file could not be located. Confirm the exact path used by the failing operation.
Entries.AppliesTo: Win32 system error return values. Not automatically equivalent to HRESULT, Windows Update, installer or vendor-specific codes.

Entries.Title: Path lookup failed
Entries.Explanation: The requested path could not be located. Check the path and its parent directories.
Entries.AppliesTo: Win32 system error return values. Not automatically equivalent to HRESULT, Windows Update, installer or vendor-specific codes.

Entries.Title: Operation denied
Entries.Explanation: The operation was denied access. Identify the target resource and execution identity before considering permission changes.
Entries.AppliesTo: Win32 system error return values. Not automatically equivalent to HRESULT, Windows Update, installer or vendor-specific codes.

Entries.Title: File sharing conflict
Entries.Explanation: Another process is using the file in a way that conflicts with this operation. Identify the owner before attempting a retry.
Entries.AppliesTo: Win32 system error return values. Not automatically equivalent to HRESULT, Windows Update, installer or vendor-specific codes.

Entries.Title: Network path unavailable
Entries.Explanation: The requested network path could not be found. Confirm the intended server and share before investigating connectivity.
Entries.AppliesTo: Win32 system error return values. Not automatically equivalent to HRESULT, Windows Update, installer or vendor-specific codes.

Entries.Title: Invalid argument
Entries.Explanation: The operation received a parameter it could not accept. Inspect the arguments and the failing API's requirements.
Entries.AppliesTo: Win32 system error return values. Not automatically equivalent to HRESULT, Windows Update, installer or vendor-specific codes.
